verdict.rationale: Migration tooling is a fair question for a package manager and build system, but the evidence documents no import or conversion tool that turns an existing project from an incumbent tool (Dockerfiles, Homebrew, pip and the like) into Nix expressions. Running alongside an existing package manager and wrapping Nix inside a Dockerfile are coexistence or user-side workarounds, not conversion tooling.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can migrate an existing project from the incumbent tool with documented import or conversion tooling
